scenes.headline: How to grade the middle of a long task
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Cairn! Today: how one new paper builds agent tasks backward from the answer, so a long rollout can be graded step by step.

scenes.text: Generate a correct hidden world with code, render the task files from it, then corrupt them in declared ways. The world is the answer key for every stage.
scenes.say: Write the correct world first, with code. Render the task files from it, then break them in declared ways. The hidden world grades every stage.

steps.say: A seeded program builds the latent world: every customer, product and transaction of a retail warehouse.
It is rendered into files, and the program checks they read back into the same world.
A declared plan corrupts them. Schema drift, duplicates, category drift. Each can be undone.
The agent repairs them, and graders compare its workspace with the correct state after every turn.

scenes.title: Progress-potential reward shaping

parts.note: One if the strict verifier accepts
parts.say: The usual pass or fail stays.

parts.note: Weighted share of the workflow done
parts.say: It adds a quarter of the progress score, where later stages count only if earlier ones are right.

scenes.say: A pass still beats any failure, but this is not policy-invariant shaping, and the paper says so.

left.title: Pass or fail only
left.say: With pass or fail alone, an all-failed group has equal rewards, so every advantage is zero.

right.title: With progress
right.say: With progress, failures are ranked by how far they got.

steps.say: One real group: eight rollouts, graded after every turn.
Terminal reward is zero for all eight. Progress separates them.

scenes.title: TB 4.0-CM, Pass@1
scenes.say: On an eighteen task Terminal-Bench subset, the recipe lifts its GLM base to zero point three seven. Small subsets, so read gains as a few tasks.

scenes.text: Write the answer before the question, and the middle of every attempt becomes gradeable.
scenes.say: Write the answer before the question, and the middle of every attempt becomes something you can grade.
A hidden world, rendered then corrupted. Progress graded every turn. And failed groups that still teach.
